description: T5: a member named twice in an envelope (top, hop, sealed, wrap; parse and outer kinds), in each kind of record and in a rotation claim, in a relay frame and an audit line (the json kind), and inside the sealed content (the open kind, with the plaintext also through the json kind): bad-json, and bad-content for the sealed content. T6: a sealed body that is lawful JSON outside I-JSON (fractions, -0, exponents, 2^53 + 1) is carried, ok; a duplicate member inside the body, or a content naming type or thread twice, is bad-content. Round 2: each case's expected verdict is the one pre-registered for its line, not the TypeScript core's (spec/adversarial/README.md, "Round 2").
test_data: Every seed, private key, content key and nonce in this file is test data: each comes from xorshiftRng(20261025) (packages/core/test/support/rng.ts). They are public; never let them protect anything real.
